## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Skill changes

- [ ] Adds a new skill
- [ ] Changes an existing skill
- [ ] Removes or renames a skill
- [ ] Does not affect a skill

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `npm run validate`
- [ ] Every new skill contains `SKILL.md`
- [ ] The plugin manifest includes every distributed skill
- [ ] The skill paths are alphabetically sorted

## Changeset

- [ ] I added a Changeset
- [ ] This change does not require a Changeset

Changesets are expected for user-facing changes.
